newsitem.title: USA: Thompson sees Q4 profit below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Thompson sees Q4 profit below estimates.

text.p: Thompson PBE Inc said it expects fourth-quarter earnings to be in the range of $0.14 to $0.15 per share before charges.
The figures are below current analysts' estimates of $0.19 per share, the company said.
The compapy blamed soft sales in certain markets and difficulties with integrating its acquisitions in the Southeast.
Despite charges that could be as high as $2 million, or $0.13 per share, the company said the fourth quarter will be profitable.
Fiscal 1997 earnings should be "significantly improved" from fiscal 1996, the company said, with fiscal 1997 sales from core business 12 to 15 percent above 1996's sales.
